cohort: Extremely obese women (BMI ≥ 50 kg/m2) at 23 weeks' gestation or greater who underwent cesarean delivery at an academic teaching hospital in Washington, DC, between January 2009 and September 2017
finding: The prophylactic use of PICO NPWT in extremely obese women undergoing cesarean delivery was not associated with a decreased risk of wound complications compared to standard dressings.
mod_finding: The use of NPWT was not associated with a decreased risk of wound complications after cesarean delivery in extremely obese women.
